quarterly.title: RSU Estimated Taxes: Safe Harbor in Four Equal Quarterly Installments (Apr 15 · Jun 15 · Sep 15 · Jan 15) #Shorts
quarterly.description: Owing in April isn't the penalty — falling short of the federal safe harbor is. The KDesk RSU Tax Planner lays the year's safe-harbor amount against cumulative withholding in four equal installments, with the due dates.\nFree calculator: https://kdeskaccounting.com/rsu-tax-calculator/\nWorkbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/rsu-planner/

vests.title: What Payroll Withholds on an RSU Vest: 22% Federal, Social Security, Medicare, Shares Sold to Cover #Shorts
vests.description: Per vest: FMV income, the 22% federal flat rate (37% over $1M), Social Security to the wage base, Medicare and Additional Medicare, total withholding, and the shares sold to cover it. From the KDesk RSU Tax Planner.\nFree calculator: https://kdeskaccounting.com/rsu-tax-calculator/\nWorkbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/rsu-planner/
